title: finance-legal personal to-dos - Noah Wilson
content:
Quick personal scratchpad for finance/legal tasks - rough, ephemeral.

Last sync: 2026-02-28 (updated list + notes). Use this to triage before updating Confluence / JIRA.

Open invoice checks:
- INV-2026-017: Acme Corp - $23,400. Received 2026-02-10, net-30. AP flagged duplicate payment possibility. ACTION: confirm payment status with AP (Priya) and confirm statement. Due: 2026-03-11.
  - Note: Vendor changed bank details on 2026-02-12, flagged in vendor portal. Send vendor verification checklist before releasing payment.
- INV-2026-018: Brightline Studios - $4,200. Services for Jan. Missing PO number on invoice. ACTION: ask AM (Rita) for PO, then route to Samir for approval.
- Recurring SaaS: LogiCloud invoice (monthly) - $1,250. Confirm auto-renew is enabled and cost center mapping is correct.

Contract redlines (in review):
- Redwood-PSA-v3 (customer: Nimbus Health) - review sections 3 (payment terms), 7 (liability cap), and SOW appendix A.
  - My proposed edits: payment terms -> net-45 (customer request), add milestone schedule to SOW A (explicit deliverables), liability cap stays at 3x MRR (legal to comment).
  - TODO: draft redline and share with legal for quick sanity check before sending to AD (target 2026-03-03).
- Partner MSA (Draft 2026-02-15) - vendor wants language around data residency. Need to loop in infra (JIRA LGL-872) and security for KMS notes.

Renewal reminders / upcoming expirations:
- CloudEdge license (contract CE-2023) - renewal notice received, term ends 2026-04-15. Rattle out negotiation points: consider moving to annual prepay for 10% discount. Assign owner: Priya to own pricing negotiation.
- Insurance policy (D&O) - renewal window opens 2026-03-20. Ask insurance broker for updated quote; target to finalize by 2026-04-05.

Immediate action items (next 7 days):
- [ ] Confirm INV-2026-017 status with AP and vendor verification (Priya).
- [ ] Request PO from AM for INV-2026-018 (Rita).
- [ ] Draft redline for Redwood-PSA-v3, send to legal (Samir).
- [ ] Add CloudEdge negotiation doc to Confluence and add pricing baseline (me).
- [ ] Block 30m with Security for discussion about Partner MSA data residency (use JIRA LGL-872).

Notes to self / friction points:
- Vendor bank change: need process note - verify via vendor portal + signed W-9 + KYC checklist before payment. Add as short SOP under Confluence: "vendor-bank-change-checklist".
- Approvals are getting slower: consider setting up an approval SLA doc for invoices > $10k (30h turnaround). Ping Finance Ops.

Meeting / follow-ups:
- 2026-03-01 10:00 AM - sync w/ Priya & Samir on outstanding redlines. Prep: bring consolidated list of contract clauses we can standardize.
- 2026-03-04 - follow up with Sales ops re: PO backlog.

Draft messages (for quick copy-paste):
- To AP / Priya: "Quick check - can you confirm receipt/status for INV-2026-017 (Acme Corp)? AP flagged a duplicate payment; I want to ensure we have vendor verification before release. Thx."
- To AM / Rita: "Can you share the PO for Brightline Studio invoice INV-2026-018? We can't process without it."

Reference links / IDs to update: 
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-INV-2026Q1 (create/update after INV reconciliation)
- JIRA: LGL-872 (Partner MSA data residency)
- GH PR: GH-PR-314 (internal template change for vendor onboarding)

Longer-term / backlog:
- Create simple checklist template for invoice verification (W-9, bank verification, PO, service evidence) - template to live in Confluence.
- Review and tighten SLA for approvals > $10k.
- Consolidate standard redline bundle for common customer asks (payment terms, IP carveouts, liability caps).

Random notes and reminders to self:
- If Nimbus asks for net-60, push back - propose milestone-based payments instead.
- Keep close on CloudEdge renewal: pricing sensitivity in Q2 budget.

End of scratchpad. Will move items into JIRA / Confluence as actions complete. Update this file with quick notes, then finalize to Confluence for team visibility.
